description: Upload an image (URL or base64, max 5 MB) to Xenarch's public CDN — for logos/branding. Returns the cdn.xenarch.dev URL. Requires confirm: true.

base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (no data: prefix needed).

confirm.description: Required true: stores the image publicly on cdn.xenarch.dev.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the image to fetch and upload.

name: xenarch_upload_asset
